GRADE 7 MATHEMATICS — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Time: 56 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Linear Inequalities at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. apply inequality symbols to inequality statements in learning situations
   B. Learners should ignore Linear Inequalities completely.
   C. Linear Inequalities is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Linear Inequalities.

2. About Linear Inequalities using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. form simple linear inequalities in one unknown in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Linear Inequalities completely.
   C. Linear Inequalities is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Linear Inequalities.

3. About Linear Inequalities when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate simple inequalities on a number line
   B. Learners should ignore Linear Inequalities completely.
   C. Linear Inequalities is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Linear Inequalities.

5. About Pythagorean Relationship at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the sides of a right- angled triangle in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Pythagorean Relationship completely.
   C. Pythagorean Relationship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pythagorean Relationship.

6. About Pythagorean Relationship using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. identify Pythagorean relationships in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Pythagorean Relationship completely.
   C. Pythagorean Relationship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pythagorean Relationship.

7. About Pythagorean Relationship when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. apply Pythagorean relationship to real-life situations
   B. Learners should ignore Pythagorean Relationship completely.
   C. Pythagorean Relationship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pythagorean Relationship.

9. About Length at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. convert units of length from one form to another involving cm, dm, m, Dm, Hm in learning situations
   B. Learners should ignore Length completely.
   C. Length is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Length.

10. About Length using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. perform operations involving units of length in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Length completely.
   C. Length is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Length.

11. About Length when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. work out the perimeter of plane figures in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Length completely.
   C. Length is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Length.

13. About Area at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the relationship between square metre (m2 ) and hectares as units of measuring area
   B. Learners should ignore Area completely.
   C. Area is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Area.

14. About Area using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. work out the area of a rectangle, parallelogram, rhombus, and trapezium in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Area completely.
   C. Area is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Area.

15. About Area when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. work out the area of circles in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Area completely.
   C. Area is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Area.

17. About Volume and Capacity at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify metre cube (m3 ) as a unit of volume in measurements
   B. Learners should ignore Volume and Capacity completely.
   C. Volume and Capacity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Volume and Capacity.

18. About Volume and Capacity using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. convert metre cube (m3 ) into centimeter cube (cm3 ) and vice versa in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Volume and Capacity completely.
   C. Volume and Capacity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Volume and Capacity.

19. About Volume and Capacity when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. work out the volume of cubes, cuboids, and cylinders in different situations
   B. Learners should ignore Volume and Capacity completely.
   C. Volume and Capacity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Volume and Capacity.

21. About Time, Distance, and Speed at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify units of measuring time in real- life situations
   B. Learners should ignore Time, Distance, and Speed completely.
   C. Time, Distance, and Speed is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Time, Distance, and Speed.

22. About Time, Distance, and Speed using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. convert units of time from one form to another in learning situations
   B. Learners should ignore Time, Distance, and Speed completely.
   C. Time, Distance, and Speed is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Time, Distance, and Speed.

23. About Time, Distance, and Speed when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. convert units of measuring distance in learning situations
   B. Learners should ignore Time, Distance, and Speed completely.
   C. Time, Distance, and Speed is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Time, Distance, and Speed.

25. About Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio completely.
   C. Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio.

26. About Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio completely.
   C. Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio.

27. About Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio completely.
   C. Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Linear Inequalities at the market in your county.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Pythagorean Relationship at the market in your county.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Length at the market in your county.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Area at the market in your county.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Volume and Capacity at the market in your county.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Time, Distance, and Speed at the market in your county.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Temperature 6 3.7 Money 14 4.0 Geometry 4.1 Angles 8 4.2 Geometrical Constructio at the market in your county.
